site.title: Site
site.description: hirist: tech jobs from hirist.tech. iimjobs: management, finance, sales and marketing jobs from iimjobs.com. both: each query on both sites.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Keywords as you would type them on the site, e.g. python developer, product manager, investment banking. Each query is searched on every selected site.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Optional city or state filter, e.g. Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad or Remote. Jobs in any of them match. Leave empty for all of India and abroad.

minExperience.title: Min experience (years)
minExperience.description: Optional: only jobs whose experience range reaches at least this many years.

maxExperience.title: Max experience (years)
maxExperience.description: Optional: only jobs whose experience range starts at or below this many years (e.g. 2 for freshers and juniors).

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs in total, across all searches; with both sites it is split evenly (a site with fewer jobs leaves the rest to the other). Each job is billed as one event.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Fetch each job's page data for the full description (plain text) and a descriptionSnippet. One extra request per job: slower, especially on iimjobs (10 s per request).

onlyNew.title: Only new jobs (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only jobs not returned by an earlier run with the same searches. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-job alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new jobs. State is kept in the key-value store "hirist-iimjobs-jobs-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy. Not needed normally: the Hirist and iimjobs APIs answer datacenter IPs directly. If set, the actor switches to a new IP whenever a request is blocked or rate-limited.
